messages:
kevin (CEO): quick weekly update from me — high level wins + a few asks. shipped APAC pilot capacity over weekend, initial p95 ~480ms which is promising. thanks team :tada:
kevin (CEO): this weeks top priorities: 1) APAC perf tuning, 2) finalize retention policy & opt-in pricing, 3) launch Performance Credits pilot for startups. short list so we can move fast.
anya (VP Product): i'll send the retention + opt-in pricing draft to Legal and Growth today. planning a short FAQ and console banner for impacted customers.
sam (VP Eng): APAC notes: we saw a noisy network card in one rack causing tail latency. infra replaced NICs + tuned kernel params. repopulating cache now, expecting p95 to drop below 400ms by EOD.
tabitha (Head of Ops): ops will schedule extended daylight on-call for APAC stabilization. also prepping migration plan for 90-day hosted logs retention; publishing migration window Tue.
emily (VP Sales): FYI — Sales will soft-launch Performance Credits to 3 beta customers this week. Need a short one-pager by Wed.
audit-bot: Compliance scan: quarterly vendor review scheduled. Action owners: Legal, Security. Report due in 10 days.
kevin (CEO): good. two asks: Eng leads please review APAC runbooks by Thu; Product & Legal please sign retention policy by Fri morning.
kevin (CEO): quick metrics snapshot: Hosted p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.6s, platform error rate 0.028% (down). Dedicated throughput +13% QoQ. APAC pilot p95 ~480ms early.
kevin (CEO): finally, thanks to the infra team for the rapid APAC rollout and to Growth for shaping the credits pilot. check-in for leads tomorrow 10:15am. stay focused. :raised_hands:
